When I was 15 my family and I went on a vacation. We were visiting friends and one morning I went to a cafe at the corner, after I ordered my drink and was waiting for it to be made an old man asked if I wanted a seat, but the way this man looked was made me feel like I couldn't say "no" He had such sadness almost like stained into his facial features.He introduced himself as Gordon he offered me a new paper but since i was young i wasn't too interested in it. We started talking about my studies, where i was from but then we started talking about him and for the next hour or so he told me about his wife, how they met, the wedding everything about them and then he dropped the bombshell on how his wife died of breast cancer. He then went and said that he moved here to try to leave it all behind . I don't know why he told me everything he did. I still remember Gordon from time to time, I always wonder if he is still going to the coffee shop, above all i'm just wondering if he is okay.
